name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Environmental bioengineer, management systems and audit documentation
addressee: To the QHSE recruitment team, DEME Group, Zwijndrecht.
subject: Application: QHSE Engineer Trainee (R0003875), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: What I find convincing about your traineeship is that safety and environment are taught together rather than kept in separate departments. In my experience they ask the same question, which is whether the paperwork describes what actually happens on site, and whether anyone goes back to check. I have spent my working life on the environmental half of that question and I would like to learn the other half properly.

My background is in management systems and data. I worked through the requirements of ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 in gap analyses against company practice, built the environmental indicators and monitoring KPIs that sit inside those systems, and created a Power Automate system that digitalised a document audit trail so evidence ended up in the right folder. I have also done data quality control and validation, which is dull until the day an auditor asks where a number came from.

What I do not have is site experience. I have not run a risk assessment on a vessel, investigated an incident, or worked a rotation offshore, and these are not small gaps for a QHSE role. They are the reason I am applying for a traineeship rather than a coordinator position. What I can offer is someone who already reads standards comfortably, who will not be thrown by an audit, and who is genuinely willing to travel and work rotation. My English is C1 and my French is native; I have no Dutch, and I would start on it.
I would welcome a conversation about the rotations, and I am glad to hear your feedback either way.
